name: redlinejs
description: Visual website feedback for coding agents: Claude reads, answers and resolves the comments reviewers leave on your live pages, with the exact element attached.

redline_review.title: Redline Cloud review (optional)
redline_review.description: A review id (rvw_…) to work on a shared review in Redline Cloud. Leave empty to use the local review in your project folder.

redline_invite.title: Redline Cloud agent invite (optional)
redline_invite.description: The review's agent token (agt_…), from the review's Agent tab at app.redlinejs.com. Leave empty for local mode.
